title: Zunder Guard rules, schema v1
description: The JSON inside a zr1_ string (base64url, no padding). Values ending in Pct are percent: 2 means 2%. Missing fields take the default; unknown fields and out-of-bounds values are refused. Numbers have at most four decimal places. Cross-field rules: maxOpenRiskPct >= maxLossAtStopPct, maxPositionPct <= maxLeverage * 100 and minLiqDistancePct > defaultStopDistancePct. The bounds are the Guard core's policy bounds (crates/zunder-guard-core/src/policy.rs); upper bounds of the risk-engine values never exceed zunder-risk's aggressive frame. Kept equal to deploy/guard/rules/src/lib.rs by a test.

maxLeverage.description: Total position value divided by equity, at most.

maxLossAtStopPct.description: Loss if the stop fills, plus expected costs, in percent of equity: the risk per trade Guard sizes every entry to.

stopPolicy.description: An entry without a stop: attach one defaultStopDistancePct away and size from it, or refuse the entry. No entry is ever without a stop.

defaultStopDistancePct.description: Optional. Distance of the stop Guard attaches, in percent of the entry price.

minLiqDistancePct.description: The liquidation price must lie at least this far from the entry, in percent of the price.

maxPositionPct.description: One position's value, in percent of equity, at most. Never above maxLeverage * 100.

maxOpenRiskPct.description: Risk to the stops summed over all open positions, in percent of equity. At least maxLossAtStopPct.

dailyLossStopPct.description: Loss since the start of the UTC day that halts new entries until the next day.

drawdownHaltPct.description: Fall from the equity peak that halts trading until a person resumes it.

markets.description: Hyperliquid market names Guard lets orders through for (for example BTC, xyz:XYZ100), "*" for every market of the main dex, "dex:*" for every market of that HIP-3 dex. HIP-3 markets are allowed only by name, never by "*". Beside "*" only HIP-3 entries may stand, and beside "dex:*" no other market of that dex. Guard reads at most two HIP-3 dexes.
